text: Из переписки Колчака с Темиревой: «Сегодня день большого значения для меня; сегодня я был вызван Sir Green'ом в посольство и получил от него сообщение, решающее мое ближайшее будущее. Я с двумя своими спутниками принят на службу Его Величества Короля Англии и еду на Месопотамский фронт… Я желаю служить Его Величеству Королю Великобритании» (с) Колчак 30.12.1917 «Генерал Ridaud, передавшим мне служебный пакет On His Majesty’s Service(«На службе Его Величества») с распоряжением английского правительства вернуться немедленно в Китай для работы в Маньчжурии и Сибири. Английское правительство после последних событий, выразившихся в полном разгроме России Германией, нашло, что меня необходимо использовать в Сибири в видах Союзников и России предпочтительно перед Месопотамией, где обстановка изменилась, по-видимому, в довольно безнадежном направлении. Моя миссия является секретной, и хотя я догадываюсь о ее задачах и целях, но пока не буду говорить о ней до прибытия в Пекин» (с) Колчак. 16.03.1918 Фактически, работал на ту же структуру, на которую 100 лет спустя стал работать кокаиновый фюрер на Украине.

text: #СВОйПуть Константин Шимчук — заместитель начальника 4-й пожарно-спасательной части Донецка МЧС России. Свой путь он выбрал ещё в детстве, вдохновившись примером дедушки, который долгие годы служил в пожарно-спасательном ведомстве. Уже более шести лет Константин вместе со своими коллегами ежедневно защищает жителей Донецка, ликвидируя пожары, устраняя последствия чрезвычайных ситуаций и спасая людей из-под завалов после обстрелов. По его словам, каждая единица техники в части предназначена для одной главной задачи — спасать человеческие жизни и предотвращать беду. Своих сослуживцев Константин называет большой семьёй, ведь именно этим людям во время выполнения задач можно безоговорочно доверить собственную жизнь. Он убеждён, что настоящая сила коллектива рождается из взаимного доверия, поддержки и готовности прийти друг другу на помощь в любой момент.

text: Захватят ли социалисты демпартию США В качестве одного из результатов промежуточных выборов называют « левение » демпартии. Но все ли так «красно» там на самом деле? Сколько соцдемов или ультралевых демократов победили на промежуточных . В палате представителей нового созыва, которая начнет работать в январе 2027 г., будут заседать пять-шесть демократов (пока подсчет продолжается), которые были официально поддержаны организацией “Демократические социалисты Америки” (DSA). Кроме того, еще 16 кандидатов, поддержанные DSA, одержали победу на выборах в местные органы власти: от заксобраний штатов до городских советов. Как дополнительное достижение DSA записало себе восемь референдумов, на которых избиратели поддержали инициативы, продвигаемые организацией (например, Proposal 2 в Мичигане, направленное на большую прозрачность выборов в части финансирования кампаний корпорациями). Стоит также учитывать трех конгрессвумен, включая демократическую социалистку Александрию Окасио-Кортес, которых DSA не поддерживала, но придерживающихся почти идентичных с организацией взглядов. Всего в палате представителей с 2027 г. будет восемь или девять открытых демократических социалистов среди демократо
author: Boris Rozhin

text: 📆 Еженедельная авторская колонка; ⚡️ Руководителя проекта «Курсы тактической медицины» с позывным «Латыш » ✅ Специально для канала Colonelcassad Соблюдение сроков антибиотикотерапии в зоне боевых действий — вопрос, который напрямую связан не только с выздоровлением, но и с сохранением жизни. В условиях, когда эвакуация может затянуться на недели, а рана загрязнена землёй, осколками и обрывками одежды, цефтриаксон становится одним из главных средств борьбы с инфекцией. Однако его эффективность напрямую зависит от того, сколько времени препарат поступает в организм. Прервать курс раньше времени, даже если кажется, что всё заживает, — значит рискнуть превратить локальный воспалительный процесс в сепсис, а обычную микрофлору — в устойчивую к антибиотикам форму При неосложнённых ранениях мягких тканей стандартный курс цефтриаксона составляет пять-семь дней. Этого достаточно, чтобы подавить большинство возбудителей и дать организму возможность справиться с остаточным воспалением. Но если рана глубокая, если затронута кость или есть признаки системной инфекции — лихорадка, лейкоцитоз, гнойное отделяемое, — курс удлиняют до десяти-четырнадцати дней. В полевых условиях, где нет возможности

However, major changes in US policy toward Ukraine, Russia, and Europe should not be expected, nor is Trump's position on Putin likely to change. The elections are also unlikely to have a significant impact on US military assistance to Ukraine, as Congress has little direct involvement in such matters. Decisions on providing assistance to allies, transferring weapons, sharing or withholding intelligence, and granting access to Starshield / Starlink fall under the authority of the executive branch. Alexander Avilov / Moskva News Agency Senior Communist Party lawmaker Nina Ostanina has submitted a formal complaint to Russia’s Culture Ministry over its decision to allow a rave to take place inside Moscow’s Lenin library on Halloween. The Russian State Library, popularly known as “Leninka,” hosted the literary-themed rave last weekend together with Russia’s largest publishing group, Eksmo-AST. Organizers said more than 3,000 people attended. Eksmo-AST said the purpose of the event, which prohibited tobacco and alcohol consumption, was to “engage a young audience with literature in the language of rhythm and light” and noted that no property was damaged. In a letter sent to Russian Culture Minister Olga Lyubimova, Ostanina reportedly asked the Culture Ministry to provide lawmakers in the lower-house State Duma with guidelines on how it determines whether to allow “entertainment and commercial events” to take place inside government buildings listed as being historically significant. “For me, the library is truly a temple, a sanctuary,” Ostan

title: Rare Thundersnow Strikes Ural Mountains, Ripping Off Roofs and Causing Power Outages
text: Rare Thundersnow Strikes Ural Mountains, Ripping Off Roofs and Causing Power Outages Nov. 6, 2026 High winds knocked down a festive tree during a strong snowstorm on Nov. 6, 2026. Social media A powerful winter thunderstorm lashed the Ural Mountains region of Russia on Friday morning, with officials and media outlets reporting that high winds ripped off the roofs of buildings and caused power outages in several regions. Videos and photos circulating on social media captured blizzard conditions in Yekaterinburg, the capital of the Sverdlovsk region, with strong winds ripping off roofs and sending debris flying through the air. “Winter arrived in Yekaterinburg with gusty winds, heavy snowfall and a thunderstorm, which the Yekaterinburg weather station recorded at 10 a.m. local time,” the Sverdlovsk region’s weather service Uralhydromet said in a statement. Meteorologists said a low-pressure system drove a cold front through the Ural mountain range, dropping temperatures below freezing and turning rain into snow. title: Kremlin Accuses Europe of Struggling to Decide Who Will Represent It in Future Security Talks
text: Kremlin Accuses Europe of Struggling to Decide Who Will Represent It in Future Security Talks Nov. 6, 2026 Kremlin special envoy Kirill Dmitriev (left) and Putin's spokesman Dmitry Peskov (right). Igor Ivanko / Pool via REUTERS The Kremlin accused Europe on Friday of struggling to decide who would represent it in future talks on ensuring the continent's security as part of a potential agreement to end the Ukraine war. The U.S., Ukraine, NATO and European officials held a meeting in Brussels on Thursday dedicated to security guarantees for Kyiv and a broader European security architecture. U.S. President Donald Trump said "a big agreement" to end the war "might involve all of Europe." Asked on Friday about what role Europe could play in future negotiations, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said it would need to ultimately be involved, but added that the European officials had so far struggled to present a unified force. "As for any ideas from the Europeans, we have not received any. We are not aware of any," Peskov told reporters at a daily briefing. title: Ukraine and Russia Trade Volley of Strikes Against Each Other’s Energy Infrastructure
text: Ukraine and Russia Trade Volley of Strikes Against Each Other’s Energy Infrastructure Nov. 6, 2026 Smoke over the Afipsky refinery in the Krasnodar region after the Ukrainian attack on Nov. 6, 2026. @supernova_plus / Telegram Russia and Ukraine launched overnight drone attacks against each other’s industrial sites and energy infrastructure on Friday. Authorities in the southern Krasnodar region said drone debris fell onto an unidentified industrial facility in the town of Afipsky and sparked a fire. The exiled news outlet Astra said it used eyewitness footage of smoke rising from an industrial area to identify the target as the Afipsky oil refinery, which has a processing capacity of 9.1 million metric tons of crude per year, or around 3% of Russia’s national total. The plant, which produces gasoline and Euro-5 diesel, has been repeatedly targeted by Ukrainian drones since the 2022 Russian invasion, with previous attacks recorded in August and July . Russia’s Defense Ministry said it intercepted 142 Ukrainian drones across Russia and annexed Crimea between Thursday night and Friday morning. title: Trump Meets Privately With Putin Envoy After White House Event Marking Oleshky Ceasefire
text: Trump Meets Privately With Putin Envoy After White House Event Marking Oleshky Ceasefire By Reuters Nov. 6, 2026 U.S. first lady Melania Trump with Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev. REUTERS / Elizabeth Frantz U.S. President Donald Trump said he met privately on Thursday with Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev after he appeared alongside Ukrainian representatives at a White House event hosted by U.S. first lady Melania Trump. Trump did not disclose what he discussed with Dmitriev but predicted a deal to end the war in Ukraine could emerge soon. "It's going to be a big agreement, and it's going to involve more than Ukraine ... I could even say it might involve all of Europe. It's going to be a big, beautiful agreement, and everyone's going to be thrilled," Trump told reporters. Trump said he did not meet with the Ukrainian representatives at the White House on Thursday. Dmitriev was at the White House for a rare face-to-face with officials from Ukraine to mark a six-day ceasefire and humanitarian mission that Melania Trump helped broker in the Russia n-controlled city of Oleshky. title: Paraguay’s president quits after millions of people’s savings frozen in bank crisis
text: Santiago Peña speaks in Asunción, Paraguay, on 3 March 2025. Photograph: Dpa Picture Alliance/Alamy View image in fullscreen Santiago Peña speaks in Asunción, Paraguay, on 3 March 2025. Photograph: Dpa Picture Alliance/Alamy Paraguay Paraguay’s president quits after millions of people’s savings frozen in bank crisis Santiago Peña’s rightwing administration had authorised Ueno Bank to drastically expand operations before collapse Tiago Rogero South America correspondent Fri 6 Nov 2026 01.16 EST First published on Thu 5 Nov 2026 13.48 EST Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Paraguay’s rightwing president, Santiago Peña, resigned on Thursday after a political and financial crisis collapsed the South American country’s banking system in recent days. At the centre of the crisis is Ueno Bank, which in just a few years under Peña went from an obscure digital bank to one of the country’s largest lenders, claiming to have about 60% of Paraguay’s adult population as customers. Last Monday, the central bank ordered Ueno into resolution over insolvency, freezing the deposits of 3 million customers, leaving hundreds of thousands of families without access to money for food and basic daily expen

title: Melania Trump calls for lasting Ukraine truce as she hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials
text: Melania Trump calls for lasting Ukraine truce as she hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials Figure caption, Watch: US First Lady Melania Trump given Ukraine's highest award for women By Laura Gozzi Published 5 November 2026 Updated 6 November 2026 US First Lady Melania Trump called for a "more enduring" ceasefire in Ukraine as she welcomed Russian and Ukrainian delegations at the White House following last week's truce in the southern region of Kherson. Hundreds of residents of the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky facing starvation and constant bombardment were able to evacuate during a six-day ceasefire, which both Moscow and Kyiv credited Trump with brokering. "The lives of innocent people must transcend the division of war. I hope Oleshky inspires greater peace," she said. The unusual White House event saw senior Ukrainian and Russian officials meet away from the setting of official US-brokered peace talks they have been holding without success since last year. text: Anti-Kremlin Political Parties Peaceful Russia and Rassvet Named ‘Foreign Agents’ Nov. 6, 2026 Pro-peace politician Yekaterina Duntsova. Yana Fitskovskaya (CC BY-SA 4.0) Russia’s Justice Ministry on Friday designated the anti-Kremlin political parties Peaceful Russia and Rassvet as “foreign agents” over accusations that they spread false information about the government and discredit the country’s electoral system. Peaceful Russia was founded earlier this year by a group of exiled opposition figures , led by former Moscow councilman and political prisoner Ilya Yashin, to unite Russia’s fragmented anti-war movement and eventually challenge President Vladimir Putin’s rule. title: Russian Security Council Calls for Rapid Deployment of Starlink Rival Satellites
text: Russian Security Council Calls for Rapid Deployment of Starlink Rival Satellites By Reuters Nov. 6, 2026 Ukrainian servicemen set up Starlink satellite internet system near the frontline town of Pokrovsk. REUTERS / Inna Varenytsia Experts on Russia's Security Council warned Friday that Russia needs to urgently expand its homegrown equivalent to Starlink, warning that Elon Musk's satellite network could be used to destabilize countries throughout the world. In a statement cited by state media, the Security Council said "it is necessary to rapidly scale up the mass production of communications satellites and terminal equipment," referring to Russia's Rassvet low-Earth orbit satellite network. Digital Development Minister Maksut Shadayev told President Vladimir Putin last month that Russia has so far launched just over 30 satellites as part of Rassvet. In comparison, Starlink has more than 10,000 active satellites. On Friday, Russia's Security Council held a meeting of its expert council to discuss issues related to information security and internet access. title: Father and Daughter Who Fled Russia Win Magnitsky Human Rights Award
text: Father and Daughter Who Fled Russia Win Magnitsky Human Rights Award Nov. 6, 2026 Alexei Moskalyov and his daughter Maria. @Govorit_NeMoskva / Telegram Alexei Moskalyov and his daughter, Maria, who fled Russia after facing political persecution for an anti-war drawing , have been awarded the 2026 Magnitsky Human Rights Award. The organization behind the annual honor announced Thursday that the Moskalyovs received the “Courage Under Fire” award for their refusal to remain silent in the face of state prosecution. “Throughout everything we have endured, Masha has remained true to the values I tried to teach her from childhood: honesty, compassion, courage and the determination to speak the truth, even when doing so comes at a terrible personal cost,” Moskalyov said in a statement. In 2023, a Russian court sentenced Moskalyov to two years in prison on charges of “discrediting” the Russian military. The case began a year earlier, after Maria, then 12, drew a picture at school depicting Ukrainian mothers protecting their children from Russian missiles. Maria was initially placed in a state orphanage before being sent to live with her estranged mother. Following his release in October 202

title: Ukraine and Russia Trade Volley of Strikes Against Each Other’s Energy Infrastructure
text: Ukraine and Russia Trade Volley of Strikes Against Each Other’s Energy Infrastructure Nov. 6, 2026 Smoke over the Afipsky refinery in the Krasnodar region after the Ukrainian attack on Nov. 6, 2026. @supernova_plus / Telegram Russia and Ukraine launched overnight drone attacks against each other’s industrial sites and energy infrastructure on Friday. Authorities in the southern Krasnodar region said drone debris fell onto an unidentified industrial facility in the town of Afipsky and sparked a fire. The exiled news outlet Astra said it used eyewitness footage of smoke rising from an industrial area to identify the target as the Afipsky oil refinery, which has a processing capacity of 9.1 million metric tons of crude per year, or around 3% of Russia’s national total. title: What Trump’s midterms debacle could mean for US support for Ukraine
text: The Republican Party's crushing defeat in midterm elections has left Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky optimistic about future support for Kyiv and stronger transatlantic relations. But with US President Donald Trump retaining broad foreign policy powers, the Democratic majority in Congress may have limited scope to bring about substantial change.
author: Simon FEISTHAUER FOURNET

title: Europe: What we know about the hoax bomb threats disrupting flights

Videos and photos circulating on social media captured blizzard conditions in Yekaterinburg, the capital of the Sverdlovsk region, with strong winds ripping off roofs and sending debris flying through the air. “Winter arrived in Yekaterinburg with gusty winds, heavy snowfall and a thunderstorm, which the Yekaterinburg weather station recorded at 10 a.m. local time,” the Sverdlovsk region’s weather service Uralhydromet said in a statement. Meteorologists said a low-pressure system drove a cold front through the Ural mountain range, dropping temperatures below freezing and turning rain into snow. title: Kremlin Accuses Europe of Struggling to Decide Who Will Represent It in Future Security Talks
text: Kremlin Accuses Europe of Struggling to Decide Who Will Represent It in Future Security Talks Nov. 6, 2026 Kremlin special envoy Kirill Dmitriev (left) and Putin's spokesman Dmitry Peskov (right). Igor Ivanko / Pool via REUTERS The Kremlin accused Europe on Friday of struggling to decide who would represent it in future talks on ensuring the continent's security as part of a potential agreement to end the Ukraine war. The U.S., Ukraine, NATO and European officials held a meeting in Brussels on Thursday dedicated to security guarantees for Kyiv and a broader European security architecture. U.S. President Donald Trump said "a big agreement" to end the war "might involve all of Europe." Asked on Friday about what role Europe could play in future negotiations, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said it would need to ultimately be involved, but added that the European officials had so far struggled to present a unified force. "As for any ideas from the Europeans, we have not received any. We are not aware of any," Peskov told reporters at a daily briefing. title: Ukraine and Russia Trade Volley of Strikes Against Each Other’s Energy Infrastructure
text: Ukraine and Russia Trade Volley of Strikes Against Each Other’s Energy Infrastructure Nov. 6, 2026 Smoke over the Afipsky refinery in the Krasnodar region after the Ukrainian attack on Nov. 6, 2026. @supernova_plus / Telegram Russia and Ukraine launched overnight drone attacks against each other’s industrial sites and energy infrastructure on Friday. Authorities in the southern Krasnodar region said drone debris fell onto an unidentified industrial facility in the town of Afipsky and sparked a fire. The exiled news outlet Astra said it used eyewitness footage of smoke rising from an industrial area to identify the target as the Afipsky oil refinery, which has a processing capacity of 9.1 million metric tons of crude per year, or around 3% of Russia’s national total. The plant, which produces gasoline and Euro-5 diesel, has been repeatedly targeted by Ukrainian drones since the 2022 Russian invasion, with previous attacks recorded in August and July . Russia’s Defense Ministry said it intercepted 142 Ukrainian drones across Russia and annexed Crimea between Thursday night and Friday morning. title: Trump Meets Privately With Putin Envoy After White House Event Marking Oleshky Ceasefire
text: Trump Meets Privately With Putin Envoy After White House Event Marking Oleshky Ceasefire By Reuters Nov. 6, 2026 U.S. first lady Melania Trump with Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev. REUTERS / Elizabeth Frantz U.S. President Donald Trump said he met privately on Thursday with Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev after he appeared alongside Ukrainian representatives at a White House event hosted by U.S. first lady Melania Trump. Trump did not disclose what he discussed with Dmitriev but predicted a deal to end the war in Ukraine could emerge soon. "It's going to be a big agreement, and it's going to involve more than Ukraine ... I could even say it might involve all of Europe. It's going to be a big, beautiful agreement, and everyone's going to be thrilled," Trump told reporters. Trump said he did not meet with the Ukrainian representatives at the White House on Thursday. Dmitriev was at the White House for a rare face-to-face with officials from Ukraine to mark a six-day ceasefire and humanitarian mission that Melania Trump helped broker in the Russia n-controlled city of Oleshky.
